8.2.1 MemIf_StatusType
[SWS_MemIf_00064] Definition of datatype MemIf_StatusType
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00392
⌈
Name
MemIf_StatusType
Kind
Enumeration
MEMIF_UNINIT
–
The underlying abstraction module or device
driver has not been initialized (yet).
MEMIF_IDLE
–
The underlying abstraction module or device
driver is currently idle.
MEMIF_BUSY
–
The underlying abstraction module or device
driver is currently busy.
Range
MEMIF_BUSY_INTERNAL
–
The underlying abstraction module is busy
with internal management operations. The
underlying device driver can be busy or idle.
Description
Denotes the current status of the underlying abstraction module and device drive.
Available via
MemIf.h
⌋
